This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be carried out every six months as indicated by 
 M6 in the above title block

The cooling water system is 
 divided to two main subsystems:

Main cooling water (Sea Water) subsystem to condensate the steam inside the 
 main condenser, condensate steam inside boiler feed pump turbine condenser and 
 cooling Secondary cooling water main coolers.

Secondary cooling water (Demi water) subsystem function to cool 6KV motors and 
 oil coolers

Main cooling water (sea water) subsystem is consisting of five branches for 
 both unit1&2, and three branches for each units 3&4 .for each branch is 
 consisting of primary sea water cleaner (Trash Rack), secondary sea water 
 cleaner (Band screen) and 6KV sea water pump.

Secondary cooling water (Demi water) subsystem is consists of storage tank, 
 Two secondary water pump, coolers and Emergency Secondary cooling closed loop 
 circuit (If the secondary Cooling pumps are out of services, The emergency 
 secondary cooling circuit will be worked for cooling the sampling system, air 
 pre-heater (Lj) and recirculation pumps about emergency secondary cooling 
 solenoid valves).

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Mahmoud Saad Eldin Bakry, tested by eng Wakeed Wahba, revised by quality control eng. Abdel-Moniem 
 AlEmam EDEPC, accepted by I&C general manager eng. Ibrahim El-Sayed, and 
 approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latef Mady: head sector of Ataka PS.

This document 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil EDEPC 
 inspection & quality control 
 general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC 
 planning. & financial predicting and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

items:
A work order must be issued; the maintenance staff should be qualified 
 maintenance manuals

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, anti static 
 hand probe to avoid electrical shock etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Obtain a copy of relay control circuit diagram of Trash Rack & Band Screen 
 cleaners
Obtain a copy of release and protection SAMA diagram of main/secondary pumps.

Obtain a copy of control circuit diagram for discharge valve (Flap Valve) of 
 main cooling water pump
The unit must be out of service
Digital multi-meter.
Screw driver kit, manual tools
Oil spry cleaner & Teflon roll.
Pneumatic Calibrator
External 24VDC power supply.
Current injector

sections.text:
Release & Protection Test for Main Cooling Water 
Subsystem

items:
Check the limit switches according to the approved MPIS and checks 
 this alarm on alarm window and adjust the stroke of trash rack.

Check level switches and check the mechanical cams of 
 Manual/Auto operating of trash rack control according to the approved MPIS and 
 check this alarm on alarm window.

Check level switches and check the mechanical cams of 
 Manual/Auto operating of control band screen for operation normal speed and 
 high speed according to the approved MPIS and check this alarm on alarm window.

Check rtd of slot winding temperature of 6kv motor according to 
 the approved MPIS and check the limit values temperature setting for release & 
 protection of main cooling pump

Check rtd of thrust bearing of main cooling pump according to 
 the approved MPIS and check the limit values temperature setting for release 
 & protection of main cooling pump

Check ultrasonic level transmitter which measure sea water 
 level according to the approved MPIS and check the limit values setting of sea 
 water level for release & protection of main cooling pump, this check need the 
 unit out service.

Check cooling water flow switch of 6kv motor according to 
 the approved MPIS and check the minimum flow setting for release & 
 protection of main cooling pump.

Check lubrication water flow switch of thrust bearing according 
 to the approved MPIS and check the minimum flow setting for release & protection 
 of main cooling pump, and check the automatic operation lubrication water 
 pumps.

Check the inlet& return hydraulic solenoid valves of discharge 
 valve (flap valve) of main cooling water pump according to approved MPIS.

Check the limit switches of percentages stroke of discharge 
 valve (flap valve) of main cooling water pump according to approved MPIS.

Check the relay control of hydraulic system for opening and 
 closing discharge valve (flap valve) in automatic and manual made of main 
 cooling water pump, this check need the unit out service.

check the relay control of hydraulic system for operating the 
 hydraulic pumps in automatic and manual mode of main cooling water pump, this 
 check need the unit out service

sections.text:
Release & Protection Test for Secondary Cooling 
Water Subsystem

items:
Check RTD of slot winding temperature of 6kv motor according to 
 the approved MPIS and check the limit values temperature setting for release & 
 protection of main cooling pump.

Check flow transmitter of secondary cooling pump according to 
 the approved MPIS and check the limit values setting of secondary water flow for 
 release & protection.

Check the level switches of secondary water tank according to 
 the approved MPIS and check the minimum level for release & protection of 
 secondary cooling pump.

Check the level switches of secondary water tank according to 
 the approved MPIS which opening and closing follow up valve automatically

If the secondary cooling pumps are out of services, the 
 emergency secondary cooling circuit will be worked for cooling the sampling 
 system, air preheater (Lj) and recirculation pumps about emergency secondary 
 cooling solenoid valves.

Check the emergency secondary cooling solenoid valves according 
 to the approved MPIS which opening and closing follow up valve automatically, 
 this check need the unit out service
